notes.sleep_apnea: CONFIRMED: diagnosed sleep apnea, 3-4 years. Tried CPAP - made it worse (discontinued). Multiple sleep specialists consulted. Recommended weight loss but unable to achieve. Currently NO medical treatment for apnea. This means every night his airway obstructs, brain micro-wakes, and restorative delta is disrupted. This explains: (1) sleeping longer but unrefreshing, (2) 1.5 hrs deep sleep avg, (3) morning restedness 3-4/10, (4) persistent fatigue despite Depth Dial. Our work helps the behavioral layer (onset, routine, cognitive quieting, relaxation response). We cannot promise morning restedness improvement if apnea remains untreated. HONEST with client: both layers needed. Explore: oral appliance, positional therapy, weight management hypnotherapy as adjunct.

notes.catch22_framework: THE CATCH-22: Sleep apnea deprives body of oxygen, causes micro-arousals 100s of times/night. This spikes cortisol, disrupts ghrelin/leptin (hunger/fullness hormones). Makes weight loss near-impossible by willpower alone. Specialists say lose weight to fix apnea, but apnea makes weight loss biologically harder. CPAP would break the cycle but client tried it and it made things worse. THREE-TRACK APPROACH: (1) Hypnotherapy for sleep behavior (current - Depth Dial, installations, ritual). (2) Hypnotherapy for CPAP retry/desensitization (new - address anxiety/discomfort that caused CPAP failure). (3) Hypnotherapy for weight management (future - emotional eating, stress snacking, late-night cravings, exercise motivation). PLUS: discuss medical weight management options (GLP-1 medications etc) with his physician.
notes.apnea_hypnotherapy_scope: What hypnotherapy CAN do: (1) calm sleep anxiety/dread that keeps nervous system revved up, (2) manage behavioral eating habits (emotional eating, stress snacking, late-night cravings), (3) desensitize CPAP anxiety to enable retry, (4) improve sleep onset and cognitive quieting, (5) airway visualization suggestions (throat muscles hold tone, nasal breathing). What hypnotherapy CANNOT do: physically open the airway, replace CPAP, cause significant weight loss alone. EVIDENCE: Oxford trial (Stradling 1998) - hypnotherapy + stress reduction maintained 3.8kg loss at 18 months. Active RCT (NCT06397365, 2025) testing hypnosis for CPAP adherence.
